data.title: 梦梦 · 烛光闺房的吊袜带巧思
data.description: 点着柑橘香薰蜡烛的卧室里，梦梦赤足坐在床沿，纤指轻巧地扣好黑色花卉蕾丝吊袜带上的银色小扣，身后的粉色细尾欢快地晃出一道弧度。她抬眸投来一个兼具优雅王女与小恶魔神采的笑意，轻声问你对今晚的特别安排是否满意。
data.location: 暖金烛光摇曳的私密卧室床沿
data.action: 赤足坐于床沿轻扣黑蕾丝吊袜带银扣，抬眼含笑凝视
data.lighting: 香薰蜡烛暖橘微光与床幔柔影勾勒身段
data.camera: 四分之三中景，突出黑蕾丝吊袜带细节与狡黠目光
data.mood: 娇媚、笃定、充满小恶魔式主动
data.promptProse: Seated barefoot on the edge of the candlelit bed, Momo deftly fastens the small silver clasp of her black floral-lace garter straps while her slender devil tail curls playfully behind her. She looks up beneath her lashes with a poised, mischievous smile bathed in warm amber glow.
data.animaCaption: Sitting barefoot on the candlelit bed, she fastens her black lace garter clasp and looks up with a teasing smile.
data.nsfwProse: Black floral-lace garter bands, satin bows, and silver clasps contrast vividly against her warm candlelit thighs.
